paper_title: Direct Search for Dark Matter Axions Excluding ALP Cogenesis in the 63-67 micro-eV Range, with The ORGAN Experiment
coupling_convention: g_agamma in GeV^-1, as plotted on y-axis
notes: ORGAN Phase 1a sets a new exclusion limit on axion-photon coupling g_agamma ≥ 3×10^-12 GeV^-1 over the mass range 63.2–67.1 μeV (15.28–16.23 GHz) at 95% confidence. This is a microwave cavity haloscope experiment using a TM010 cylindrical resonator in an 11.5 T magnetic field at ~5.2 K. The limit excludes the ALP cogenesis model in this mass range. Local dark matter density assumed to be 0.45 GeV/cm³ (all axions). The mass range is encoded as a horizontal line at the coupling value spanning the stated mass interval. Gaps in the exclusion plot (15.58–15.61, 15.65–15.69, 15.96–16.15 GHz) due to mode-mixing are not scanned; duty cycle is ~74%. | selector: figure_vision over text (quality (1, 1, 1, 1, 2, 0, 0.75, 18)) | Vision: The exclusion plot (FIG. 4) shows ORGAN Phase 1a results in the 63-67 μeV mass range (15.28-16.23 GHz frequency). The x-axis is labeled in frequency (GHz) and mass (μeV); conversion to eV uses m[eV] = 4.136e-15 * f[Hz]. The y-axis shows g_agamma in GeV^-1 on a log scale. The green shaded region represents the ORGAN Phase 1a exclusion limits, which surpass the ALP Cogenesis model band (yellow) in several frequency windows. The lower boundary of the exclusion region (the sensitivity limit) traces a relatively flat curve around 7.5-8.5 × 10^-12 GeV^-1 across the scanned range, with slight variations due to mode-mixing regions (gaps in coverage). The KSVZ and DFSZ theoretical model bands are shown for reference at lower couplings.
